              WELCOME

              Worldwide Business of Business

              A tiny trading firm that lives on this page.

              It started in January 2023 with one man at one desk. Every trade he and his staff make uses a real S&P 500 stock's real price move. Good days get people hired and floors added. Bad days get people fired.

              It keeps running whether or not anyone is watching. Click a floor to zoom in on the people, and read what they are thinking in the feed.

              HOW IT WORKS

              A day trading firm that grows or shrinks on real S&P 500 prices, replayed from January 2023. You are watching, and you can fire people.

              • THE STARTOne man, one desk. Every trade uses a real stock's real move that day, multiplied by how much risk the trader takes.
              • HIRINGA day that earns 10% or more adds one person at the close. Each floor seats 10; a new floor opens when the ones below are full.
              • LOSSESA day that loses 25% or more costs that day's worst earner their job.
              • THE CLOCKOne trading week passes every four hours, the same for every visitor. The firm is replaying history from January 2023 and will switch to live prices when it catches up to today.
              • WATCHINGClick a floor to zoom in. The feed shows what people are thinking; click an entry to jump to that person.
              • FIRINGOpen a profile from the People tab to fire someone. A replacement is hired on the spot.
